products.name: MG Mini DC UPS – 10000mAh Network Power Bank
products.description: MG MG-606 multi-output Mini UPS / Network Portable Power Bank with a built-in lithium battery labelled 10,000mAh (37Wh). Designed for backup power to compatible Wi-Fi routers, modems and other low-power equipment with selectable 5V, 9V or 12V DC outputs. Check voltage, connector, polarity and power requirements before ordering.
details: Product: Multi-output Mini UPS / Network Portable Power Bank
Functions: Auto start when plugged in, manual power off and LED status indicators (box claims)
Protection: Overload and short-circuit protection (box claim)
Intended use: Compatible routers, modems, wireless phones and CCTV (check specifications)
Backup duration: Not stated; varies with connected load
Warranty badge: 1 year printed on box; confirm actual seller coverage before purchase
Packaging instructions: Recharge every 3 months if unused; avoid detergent cleaners
products.shortDescription: MG-606 Mini UPS for compatible Wi-Fi routers and network equipment. The box lists a 10,000mAh (37Wh) lithium battery, 5V/9V/12V DC output options and 25W maximum output power.
benefits: Backup-power support for compatible networking equipment during electricity interruptions; actual runtime depends on connected load.
Selectable 5V / 9V / 12V DC outputs plus 5V USB charging.
USB-C output ratings printed on the box: 5V/3A, 9V/2A and 12V/1.67A.
Automatic start when plugged in and manual power-off switch (features listed by manufacturer).
Multi-LED status indicators and claimed overload / short-circuit protection.
specifications: Product type: Multi-output Mini UPS / Network Portable Power Bank
Controls: Output-voltage selector and manual power-off switch (manufacturer description)
Indicators: Multiple LED status indicators (manufacturer description)
Appearance shown on package: White / silver
whoShouldBuy: Customers seeking backup power for compatible Wi-Fi routers and modems during power cuts.
Users of supported low-power networking, wireless-phone or CCTV devices, subject to their power requirements.
Confirm the device voltage, current, connector dimensions and polarity before buying.
included: Exact box contents, cable set and included adapters are not shown or verified in the supplied packaging photographs; please confirm with HB Gadget BD support.
importantNote: Specifications and features are transcribed from the MG-606 packaging; independent electrical performance and capacity have not been tested.
Backup duration is not specified on the box and depends on the connected load and battery condition. Do not assume a fixed runtime.
Match your device's voltage, connector and polarity; keep the connected load within the printed maximum output power of 25W.
The packaging displays a '1 Year Warranty' badge, but applicable seller warranty, claim procedure and coverage require confirmation from HB Gadget BD support.
Manufacturer storage guidance: Charge at least once every three months when not in use.
Read the product instructions before use. The box says mild warmth during charging can be normal and advises cleaning without detergents.
